notes: "Kekerasan air (GH) 4–20 dGH": the facts give GH 4–20 with no unit, so 'dGH' is a small addition.
"Jangka hayat ... 10–15 tahun (sumber lain)": this is supported by the facts (source 8).

"Ia sukar mencari makanan" and "ia perenang yang lemah" in the beginner FAQ: these are supported, but they are presented as reasons the source gave for 'not suitable for beginners'. The facts don't state that link.
"Boleh, tetapi hanya dengan ikan yang perlahan": this leaves out the advice to keep it apart, which is minor.
"Siapa sebenarnya penternak pertamanya tidak direkodkan" – not in the facts (unsupported claim).
"10–15 tahun (sumber lain)" is supported, but the intro says "penglihatannya terhad" – facts say vision is impaired, which is acceptable.
"sediakan tangki ... penapis yang disediakan khas" / "ia perlukan tangki dan penapis yang disediakan khas" – generalisation not directly stated.
"kantungnya mudah pecah" given as the reason it is not suitable for beginners – facts only say not suitable for beginners, with no reason given.
"Ada juga yang memberi salad dan timun" – facts say lettuce and cucumber, and "salad" is a loose rendering of lettuce.
Size "10–20 cm" – facts say 10–20.3 cm; this is roughly acceptable.
Care table GH "4–20" has no unit; this is minor.
"Sumber menyarankan kolam kira-kira 3,800 liter seekor dengan kedalaman sekurang-kurangnya 90 cm hingga lebih 1 m" is a mild merge of two sources. It is supported.
"Ia hidup lama dan boleh membesar dengan besar, jadi rancang kolam yang cukup luas sebelum membeli" is a small generality and is not stated as a recommendation in the facts.
"Kolam simen menaikkan pH, jadi kolam jenis ini perlu dikedap" is supported.
"Pada tahun 1980-an" and "sekitar 1982" are supported.
The heading "Rakan sekolam" and the answer "Boleh, kerana penjagaannya hampir sama" are slight paraphrases. They are supported.
"Sumber yang sama menegaskan" ties the 'not goldfish' statement to the 'Asian carp' source. This matches source 2.
"Pada ikan yang jarang ditemui, siripnya sepanjang badan" matches the facts.
"Sesetengah peminat di Jepun" matches the facts.
"Penternak koi pakar" is supported.
"Sirip dan ekornya... dua pertiga" is supported.

"kolam tanpa objek tajam sangat penting" and "ikan ini boleh hidup puluhan tahun dan membesar besar": mild generalisations. The first rests on the sharp-objects fact, but the 'sangat penting' emphasis is an addition.

"Dijual di kedai ikan hiasan dan kedai kolam": the facts say 'pet and pond shops', so this is a fair paraphrase. The 'Kolam' table row merges two sources (90 cm and >1 m) into one range, which is acceptable.
"tidak terlalu terdedah kepada arus yang kuat": slight embellishment of the advice about slow swimming in strong currents.
"kolam simen ... permukaannya perlu disalut atau dikedap": 'disalut' (coated) is not in the facts. The facts only say to seal the pond.
"Sirip terus memanjang apabila ikan semakin tua, jadi ikan dewasa mempunyai sirip paling panjang": the facts support this, since older fish have the longest fins.
"Ikan itu kurang laku, lalu Blue Ridge ... mengacukkannya dengan koi": supported.
"Air yang bersih, kolam tanpa objek tajam dan pengendalian yang berhati-hati membantu mengelakkannya" (in the FAQ): this implies prevention of torn fins. It is mostly supported.
